scope: Project-level SI disclosure; not a per-file authorship audit.

runtime_assistance.boundary: Validated host code computes A* geometry and numerical assessments.

data_provenance.distinction: Scientific source data, host-derived numerical results, synthetic test fixtures and SI-generated explanations are distinct artifact categories.

demo_narration.publication_status: Demo URL recorded; the team manages delivered-media credits and metadata.

publication_requirements.si_generated_images_and_video: Include a visible SI-generation watermark if used.
publication_requirements.si_generated_audio: Acknowledge SI generation in descriptive text and media metadata.
publication_requirements.si_assisted_code_and_data: Retain this project disclosure with distributed source and data provenance; distinguish synthetic or SI-generated material from scientific observations.
publication_requirements.nasa_branding: SI-generated content must not use, contain or modify NASA branding or design elements.
